# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.5

<!-- update-summary: 修复更多歌词源候选中断、暂停播放歌词回跳、空歌词设置导致启动异常与长标题表情乱码；改善 AI 维护取消响应，清理官网旧 Beta 文案。 -->

## Fixes and improvements

- LRCLIB, AMLL and Kugou no longer let an unusable first identity-matched candidate hide a later valid recording. Attempts remain bounded; cancellation and HTTP access/rate-limit rejection are not bypassed.
- Treat malformed candidate TTML/encoding as a candidate failure so other verified recordings remain eligible.
- Preserve the interpolated playback position when a pause/resume event reuses the unchanged native timestamp and position. Fresh native observations and seeks still take precedence.
- Normalize a persisted null Lyrics section without crashing settings migration or discarding unrelated preferences. Existing absent lyric choices remain disabled; fresh-install defaults remain unchanged.
- Request AI maintenance cancellation asynchronously and retain both work and callback cleanup ownership before model/cache maintenance. Slow cancellation callbacks no longer run synchronously on the initiating caller.
- Avoid splitting an emoji surrogate pair at the title limit; avoid allocating a copy of a large clipboard body just to display its first line.
- Remove remaining AI lyrics Beta labels from the bilingual website and correct stale UI-label regression assertions. Model identities, downloads and semantic limitations are unchanged.

## Verification boundaries

Each corrected behavior has a focused regression reproduction. Repository-wide managed and
script checks are complemented by the required Windows application/package CI. Linux cannot
execute Windows DPAPI or native WinUI paths. No new real-player, GPU, model-quality or
physical two-device test is claimed. A review and passing tests cannot certify zero remaining bugs.
The previously deferred separate security work remains outside this corrective release.

## Compatibility

Semantic version: 0.3.1-beta.5. PE/MSIX version: 0.3.1.5. Immediate upgrade baseline:
v0.3.1-beta.4. Stable remains v0.2.1. Existing models, settings and data are retained.

## 中文说明

更多歌词源现在可以跳过坏候选继续找有效歌词；修复播放器只更新暂停状态时歌词倒退、
歌词设置空值导致迁移异常、长标题截断表情的问题。AI 清理/切换操作不再让取消回调
同步卡住调用方，但仍会等真正退出后才维护模型或缓存。官网同步移除旧的 AI 歌词 Beta 文案。
